story.title: Want help with something getting in the way?
story.subtitle: Tick what would help. Skip anything. You don't have to explain any of it.
story.footer: What you share here helps t.ROY build your resume and find resources. To do that, it goes to the AI services we use, and if you sign in or make an account, it's saved there. It's never used to judge you. Skip anything you don't want to share.
story.recordNote: We never ask what a charge was. If a record is in the way, tick it, and t.ROY points you to employers and help for people with records.
story.narrativeLabel: {label}: what kind of help would make a difference?
story.narrativePlaceholder: For example: a ride to early shifts.

options.criminal_record: A record (jobs and help for people with records)

credentials.promptTrade: Getting back into your trade: do you hold a license, certificate or card for it?
credentials.promptDefault: Any training, certificate or license you have, or are working on?
credentials.hint: One per line. Pick what kind it is, then the year you got it or whether it's current, expired or in progress.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.when: When did you get it, or is it current?
credentials.whenPlaceholder: The year, or current, expired, in progress
credentials.needsWhen: Add the year you got it, or say if it's current, expired, in progress or completed.
credentials.needsName: Keep the name to just the name. Put expired, lapsed, suspended or the year in the box below.
credentials.needsKind: The name says what kind it is. Pick that kind, or take the word out of the name.
credentials.needsPermit: That sounds like a permit. Pick Permit as the kind.

paste.label: Or paste the text
paste.placeholder: Paste your resume here. Any formatting is fine.

help.summary: Help: getting your resume, or remembering where you worked
help.linkedinBody: Open your profile, tap More under your photo, then Save to PDF. Upload that file here.
help.indeedBody: Go to <link>profile.indeed.com/resume</link>, tap Download Resume, and pick PDF. Upload that file here.
help.forgetTitle: Can't remember where you worked, or when?
help.forgetBody: These free, official sources can remind you. They open on the provider's own site. We never see or store them.
help.irs: IRS Wage and Income Transcript: every employer that reported your wages
help.workNumber: The Work Number: your free yearly employment report
help.credly: Credly: digital badges and certificates you earned

keep.title: You already have a saved resume.
keep.question: Start a new resume, or replace your current one?
keep.explain: New: your saved resume stays in My resumes, just as it is. Replace: the earlier version stays in its history, and you can bring it back from My resumes.

saved.askSubtitle: This won't change anything until you pick.
saved.subtitle: Here is your page as it stands.
saved.failed: Not saved to your account yet. Your work is still on this page.
saved.onComputer: Saved on this computer. Sign in to keep it in your account.
saved.draftBadge: Draft: check it before you send it.
saved.keptNew: Your earlier resume is in My resumes, just as it was.
saved.keptReplace: Your earlier version is in its history. You can bring it back from My resumes.
saved.nextFinished: First, tell t.ROY what to lead with. Then he builds the full page.
saved.nextDraft: First, tell t.ROY what to lead with. Then he builds the full page and checks every line with you. Until then it stays a draft.
saved.editor: Fix more lines in the editor

reward.workingSubtitle: t.ROY is tidying it and starting your resume.
reward.workingLabel: Working from the information you provided
reward.workingNote: One moment. You don't need to do anything.
reward.title: Here's your page.
reward.subtitle: t.ROY builds your resume from what is on it.
reward.contactLabel: A phone or email employers can reach you at
reward.contactHint: t.ROY can't make this one up. Add it now, or build without it.

problem.empty: Type it in the box first.
problem.not_contact: That doesn't look like a phone number or an email. Try again.
problem.unchanged: That's the same as before. Change it, or save the page as it is.

reward.editor: Fix lines yourself first, in the editor

quick.promptName: Start with the name you want on the page.
quick.promptTitle: What did you call this work? A job, a gig, volunteer work, or work for family all count. Use your own title.
quick.promptDuty: At {place}, what did you actually do? Say one thing out loud or type it as you would tell me.
quick.promptDone: That's a real line to build from. Add the place and dates if you know them, then I'll organize what you gave me. You can add another job next.
quick.subtitleAdding: Same as before: the job, and one thing you did there.
quick.subtitleFirst: A job, a gig, or work you did for family. Then one thing you did there, in your words.
quick.coachIntro: I can do the organizing and writing. You tell me what happened. We can start small and build from there.
quick.helpHidden: Help is hidden. Your answers stay here.
quick.fieldTitle: What did you do there? (your job title)
quick.fieldEmployerPlaceholder: The place, or who you worked for
quick.fieldDutyPlaceholder: For example: I ran the grill on the breakfast line.
quick.missingTitle: Add the job title or the place.
quick.missingDuty: Add one thing you did there.
quick.goingAfter: Going after: {target}. We build only what that job needs.
